criterion_text: A real private-socket tmux/Nession Agent comparison for plain PTY and `-C` proves or explicitly isolates each OSC 52/5522 direction, including DECRQM/DECRPM, mode enable, MIME event, read/write reply and `id`, with exact settings/bytes and no unverified `-C` parity claims.

verifiers.summary: tmux control mode carries OSC 52/5522 in both directions and plain attach forwards both with the shipped clipboard settings

evidence.value: tmux -C %output carried OSC 52 and OSC 5522 byte-exactly (ESC ]52;c;Zm9vYmFy ESC \ and ESC ]5522;type=read;Lg== ESC \)
tmux -C send-keys -H delivered OSC 5522 reply bytes to a raw pane reader: 1b5d353532323b747970653d726561643b51513d
plain tmux attach (script PTY, TERM pinned as process.rs does) forwarded OSC 52 and OSC 5522 to the outer terminal with the shipped set-clipboard external + clipboard terminal feature
exact SHA 3cde8bf37e9be2174032255bc5c720a01975d4b7: server config sets set-clipboard external and terminal-features ',*:clipboard'; tmux 3.4
